rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey, Tora... Is Umon-san somewhere
the Cloud Sea's tides don't affect?

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0002
rows.name: Hmm, why do you ask, mo?

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0003
rows.name:
Ever since we went to help Nia...
even now, the Cloud Sea is really
low, right?

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0004
rows.name:
I was wondering if we'd need
to plan different routes
based on the conditions.

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0005
rows.name:
You're right. The Cloud Sea's
tides definitely affect which
areas you all can access.

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0006
rows.name:
Sometimes you can swim through the
Cloud Sea and reach places that were
inaccessible before...

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0007
rows.name:
On the other hand, some areas
might become unavailable when
they sink beneath the Cloud Sea.

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0008
rows.name:
That's exactly it. That's why
I was wondering what kind of
location we're headed to.

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0010
rows.name:
But don't worry, mo! The route to old
man Umon's shipyard isn't affected by
the Cloud Sea, mo!

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0012
rows.name:
If we could only reach it during
high tide, we'd have to rest
somewhere until the Cloud Sea rose.

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0014
rows.name:
I wouldn't mind taking a proper rest
at an inn and patiently waiting for
the Cloud Sea level to change.

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0015
rows.name:
Because being inside Rex's
helmet is tiring...

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0016
rows.name:
Alright, alright, we can
do that the next time we
visit the inn in Torigo.

rows.label: fev03_030_125_msg0017
rows.name:
For now, let's head for old man Umon's
shipyard, mo!
